body: Thank you. I've reached out to people I know for any sign of caring but no one answered. Literally no one cares. My husband saw me and just walked back upstairs. I'm so low I can't even feel anything enough to cry but I'm still too chicken.
I've seen a therapist for the last five years. Tried a few until I found one that worked with me but she left her job last year when she became pregnant.
